As the bipartisan January 6 commission recommended, Donald Trump and his enablers must be punished for incitement to insurrection and other crimes against the American public. I have forcefully and consistently fought back against seditionists and will continue to work to heal and strengthen democracy through measures like the Electoral Count Act Reform, which passed at the close of the 117th Congress.
